hazards.reason: Prototype mixes fake forecast-skill formulas, incomplete oscillation states, uninitialized-data execution, and authoritative oscillation labels. The source was restored after a coarse whole-file removal was rejected; hazardous procedures must be isolated surgically rather than treating the entire module as absent.

Omnibus spectral prototype exposes real algorithm names while EEMD/SSA/CEEMDAN and other paths contain zero, empty, placeholder, or inconsistent behavior. Preserve potentially useful implemented routines while isolating each hazardous algorithm path.

Dual metric/Christoffel paths are incomplete while higher curvature and climate-risk interpretation depend on them. Preserve unrelated geometric code and quarantine only computations whose derivative chain reaches the incomplete paths.
Curvature/eigenvalue thresholds are transformed into named tipping probabilities/timescales without a validated interpretation mapping.
Fallback max/min eigenvalues are hard-coded and can masquerade as numerical conditioning diagnostics.
Physical state initialization inserts fixed placeholder relative humidity under a physical field name.
General physical-core path includes a placeholder fixed solar-declination value and simplified constants/closures without sufficiently narrow semantics.
Julia/Haskell or advanced array interoperability is described by an FFI bridge despite placeholder/absent backend implementation.
Checkpoint/restart is placeholder behavior inside a scheduler whose future global resource role should move to Commons.
Threshold counts are labeled as Betti numbers without computing homology/cohomology ranks.
Global gluing uses an arbitrary union while the interface implies a reconstructed global section.
A solver path explicitly labels its convergence test fake and does not check the actual residual.
Some Fisher/connection/tensor calculations use dummy or synthetic observations internally rather than a fully explicit statistical-model input.
MPI/NCCL/WMMA compatibility shims must never retain the identity of the real accelerated capability in evidence-producing runs.
